The Anchor

Never Miss Your Moment.

The cure is the claim. The brand lives in the moment after — the morning life resumes, louder than before. One promise. Two countries. Never miss your moment.

One Way In · The Device

We only show the bounce back.

Six characters, one year of lived moments. We skip the down time and show the comeback. Bounce Back: day-three morning, the stall reopened, the routine resumed, life a little louder than before. The story is always the return.

We don't sell the sickness. We sell the morning you get back.

The year arc · four moments per character
01Routine02Down time03Day-304Bounce Back
And Also

It's not just the cast.

The cast is the familiarity driver that builds trust over time, distinct for each country. They are 30% of the big picture. Data is truth. Whatever builds engagement gets budget. Challenges will still play a role — but the voice is evidenced by real stories, not medical claims.

The pillars run under every character — civic protection (counterfeit + resistance + completion: one chain), education (AL works 2–10× better with food — uncontested territory), and the pharmacist counter, where the customer asks for the real thing by name. The cast is the spine — not the whole story.

Why · The Pivot

The challenge is fatigued. So we tell stories.

KeepKnock out Malaria in 3 days. The ratified promise, the NMA spine — untouched.
EvolveFrom challenge-and-prize to characters people follow. The engine is mature, not broken — the format just tired. The last NMA push ran 0.24%. The data made the call.
BuildA cast the audience adopts — Tunde, Adaeze, Aisha, Chidi, Emeka, Folake — so the brand becomes a household, not an ad. Always-on beats episodic.
In Market · Two Countries

One cure.
Two voices.

🇳🇬 NG · Anthem
Vibrant. Ochre + clay. Hustle, recovery, return. NMA-endorsed. Time claims OK.
🇬🇭 GH · Refrain
Natural. Artemisia + parchment. Community, completion, knowledge. No NMA. No contests.
How they connect
🇳🇬 NigeriansLoud, mobile, skeptical — they connect when Shal'Artem shows up in Pidgin, with real faces and visible proof it works (real stories), not clinical claims.
🇬🇭 GhanaiansQuieter, relationship-led, word-of-mouth driven — they connect when Shal'Artem feels trusted by family and pharmacist before it feels promoted.

Sprint · +6-wk NG push

The launch. Two markets, one cure. The cast arrives — six characters, two countries, one story of arrival. The bounce back lands: day-three morning, the stall reopened, the routine resumed.

Strategic spine

Nigeria runs flagship pace (TikTok-first); Ghana establishes (FB-first). Sprint 1 lifts NG to 3×/wk across six challenge weeks ending in ambassador reveal.

KPI: Reach per post. Cast recognition rate. Pharmacist counter asks.

Sep–Nov
Louder Than Before
Always-on → Nov sprint
Cast deepens — civic + education pillars
Pharmacist counter mechanic runs
Sprint 2 · 12-post push · Nov
Baseline · NG 2×/wk · GH 1×/wk

The brand gets louder. The cast deepens into civic protection and education — AL works 2–10× better with food, the pharmacist knows your name. November sprint amplifies before dry-season peak.

Strategic spine

Nigeria converts reach into trust; Ghana deepens relationship-led community. Sprint 2 (12 posts) lands before the malaria peak. Data reweights platform budget toward highest engagement.

KPI: Engagement lift. Cost-per-engagement drop. Counterfeit alert shares.

Ambassador voices surface

Always-on · both markets

Peak malaria season. The cast hands the mic to real people — UGC bounce-back stories, evidence by lived experience not clinical claims. Ambassadors surface from the most-engaged voices.

Strategic spine

Both markets run community cadence. WhatsApp channels real stories as social proof. The brand becomes the reference, not the reminder.

KPI: UGC volume. Ambassador surfacing. Share rate.

WhatsApp hits 13,000 target
Baseline · both markets

The year closes owned. Community-led content at lower spend. The audience we built does the work — algorithm-independent, ours to keep. The brief for FY27 is written from this year's data.

Strategic spine

Both markets run community cadence. WhatsApp passes 13,000 target (8,000 NG · 5,000 GH). Year-in-review ships; FY27 brief is data-ready.

KPI: Repeat purchase signal. Brand love. Hand-off ready.
